title: Learning under Bounded Manipulation for Quadratic Incentive Design
abstract: arXiv:2611.26736v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study a repeated quadratic incentive design game in which a leader learns a follower's private type from noisy observations of the follower's actions and uses her estimates in an affine incentive rule. The follower knows the leader's learning policy, which incorporates past observations to produce estimates of the follower's type, and can deviate from his myopic best response to influence the leader's future estimates. We ask how the follower's ability to manipulate these observations affects the leader's performance. Under a manipulation budget $C_T$ constraining the expected cumulative squared deviation of the follower's actions from his myopic best response, we establish a minimax regret rate of order $\max\{\log T, \min\{C_T,T\}\}$ for approximately rational followers. translated_title: 有界操纵下的二次激励设计学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一个重复的二次激励设计博弈，其中领导者从跟随者行动的噪声观测中学习跟随者的私人类型，并在仿射激励规则中使用其估计值。跟随者知道领导者的学习策略，该策略利用过去的观测来产生对跟随者类型的估计，并且跟随者可以偏离其短视最优响应以影响领导者未来的估计。我们探究跟随者操纵这些观测的能力如何影响领导者的性能。在操纵预算 $C_T$ 约束跟随者行动相对于其短视最优响应的期望累积平方偏差的条件下，我们为近似理性的跟随者建立了阶为 $\max\{\log T, \min\{C_T,T\}\}$ 的极小极大遗憾率。我们的信息论下界适用于领导者和跟随者的一般类因果估计与操纵策略。我们提供了一个简……
tldr: 本文研究了重复二次激励设计博弈中跟随者在操纵预算约束下策略性影响观测的问题，建立了近似理性跟随者的极小极大遗憾率 $\max\{\log T, \min\{C_T,T\}\}$ 及相应的信息论下界。
en_tdlr: This paper studies strategic manipulation of observations by followers with a manipulation budget in repeated quadratic incentive design games, establishing a minimax regret rate of $\max\{\log T, \min\{C_T,T\}\}$ for approximately rational followers along with a matching information-theoretic lower bound.
